summary: run-refactor-implementation-acceptance: deterministic evidence for one execution-plans/<target>; excludes code changes, approval, commit, release, deploy; default evidence_only, controlled_validation needs typed commands and isolated roots; prefer clean-HEAD commit candidate, explicit frozen baseline, never infer candidate^; require complete manifests, contract or compact-vdd bundle, action DAG, command registry, knowledge context, and validated Skill-input receipt; missing or ambiguous inputs => prerequisite_blocked; stale Quick Dev candidate binding returns to quick-dev-tdd-adapter; knowledge catalog staleness is degraded but usable, other context failures require repair; runs are append-only and binding-derived, stale bindings create successors; deterministic_only finalizes from replayed controlled receipts without Bootstrap; semantic routes require immutable decision, fresh inspect-lineage, bounded route-acceptance, and finalized Bootstrap import; Bootstrap launch requires explicit high-cost acknowledgement, with later discovery requiring user confirmation; exact reuse only via bootstrap-import-envelope.v3 with clean current lineage and exact bindings; P2 closes deterministically, P0/P1 requires Quick Dev handoff plus audit-repair-completeness; round policy: full Round 1, one focused verifier after eligible repair, deterministic closure after two complete rounds, manual_pause after three, never Round 4; ADR-0054 manual-pause closure requires repaired findings, protocol review, challenge-bound maintainer acknowledgement, and final recomputation; acceptance-passed never authorizes commit, release, or archive; pure Godot unsupported; tests or Bootstrap clean alone do not satisfy Program DoD
